headline: Regulators clear consumer, environmental groups to weigh in on merger that would form world's largest regulated electric utility
summary: State regulators are reviewing the proposed merger between Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy.  The Public Service Commission took another step Thursday, voting to allow several groups and government officials to formally participate in the case.  If approved, the merger would create the world's largest regulated electric utility.

summary: Governor Abigail Spanberger announced she will intervene in the proposed $67 billion merger between Florida-based NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy on Thursday. It will mark the first time a Virginia governor has taken such an action at the State Corporation Commission.

headline: Spanberger steps into Dominion-NextEra merger review, citing concerns over costs and jobs
summary: Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger is stepping into the review of the proposed merger between Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy, saying she wants to make sure the deal benefits Virginia customers, workers and the state’s energy future.  Spanberger announced Thursday that she plans to formally intervene in the State Corporation Commission’s review of the proposed $67 billion deal.  It would make her the first Virginia governor to take that step in an SCC case.
